newsitem.title: UK: Soft oils higber on quiet European veg oils market.
newsitem.headline: Soft oils higber on quiet European veg oils market.

text.p: Soft oils closed higher in quiet trading on the European vegetable et during Monday afternoon.
Traders said it had been a one-sided market with plenty of sellers but no buyers.
"Most thought Chicago was going to open lower, but when it came in higher they decided to call it a day," one trader.
Chicago futures opened sharply higher on forecasts calling for hot and dry weather during the early part of the week and after lower rainfall than expected over the weekend.
Ample supplies and poor exports are expected by many traders to push palm oil stocks in Malaysia up to around one million tonnes.

Oct/Dec traded from $495 down to $490 a tonne cif.
Among refined palm oils RBD oil and olein were $2.50 to $5 lower with no further business reported during the afternoon.
Coconut oil sellers reduced prices during the afternoon after failing to attract any buying interest on an over-supplied market.
Opening offers had been $10 up but by the close this had been reduced to $5 and buyers were still not showing any interest.
Palmkernel oil finished unchanged to $5 down.
